name: Turkey-Spinach Dip Pinwheel Bento Box with Rainbow Carrots, Blueberries & Trail Mix

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes a 4-compartment bento box. Please adjust the recipe as needed to accommodate the size of your bento box or food storage containers.
Wash and dry blueberries. Place in one of the small compartments of the bento box.
Place carrots in the medium compartment and trail mix in the second small compartment of the bento box.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup rainbow baby carrots
⅓ cup trail mix

instructions.primary_message: Place lavash (about 8 x 10-inches in size) on a flat surface. Spread spinach dip over the bread in an even layer, making sure to spread it out to the edges.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (8 x 10-inch) piece lavash bread
½ cup spinach dip

instructions.primary_message: Layer turkey over the spinach dip. With the short edge of the lavash facing towards you, tightly roll the bread into a cylinder. Slice bread crosswise into 6 even pieces and place in the large compartment of the bento box.
instructions.secondary_message: 4 oz oven roasted turkey breast, sliced

instructions.primary_message: Cover bento box and refrigerate until ready to eat. Enjoy!
